title: Digital Nitrogen Tyre Inflator Heavy - NITROJET 1000 HMV
description: Heavy duty digital nitrogen tyre inflator for vehicles up to 150 PSI with external tank and pressure booster.
subtitle: Heavy Duty
fullDescription: Heavy duty digital nitrogen tyre inflator for fuel stations and commercial applications. Features three digital readouts, external tank with pressure gauge and safety relief valve for nitrogen storage, air and nitrogen input pressure option available in single machine, and can be used for vehicle tyre ranging from two wheeler, car, SUV, mini truck, bus and truck up to 150 PSI.
features: Three digital readouts one for set pressure, tyre pressure and other one for tyre count & error count
LCD display with back light to provide good visibility
Display remain at same set pressure value even at power on-off cycle
Audible and visual end of the cycle signal indicators
LED indication for the status of operation
Soft touch and durable membrane keys suitable for outdoor
Separate keys for set pressure increment and decrement
Flat key for empty or puncture tyre
VAC key (VACUUM KEY) for first time nitrogen filling
Confirm to operate method for overpressure setvalue with display blink notification
Computer power chord adapter with fuse protection and switch on indicator
Pressure switch for automatic nitrogen generation cut-off
Pressure gauge for input air pressure indication and external tank nitrogen pressure indication
Safety pressure relief valve available for internal tank
Reliable PSA method for nitrogen generation
Air and nitrogen input pressure option available in single machine
External tank with pressure gauge and safety relief valve for nitrogen storage
Can use for vehicle tyre ranging from two wheeler, car, SUV, mini truck, bus and truck up to 150 PSI

specifications.display: 3 LCD display (tyre pressure, set pressure and tyre counter)

specifications.functionalKeys: Membrane keypad suitable for outdoor application
